key_decisions.decision: Retain koinōnia as partnership and link it to the book-wide participation network.
Discern what truly matters preserves the evaluative force of ta diapheronta.
Retain imperial guard for praitōrion; note broader governmental/local possibilities.
Render sōtēria as deliverance while preserving salvation/vindication range in apparatus.
Retain concise to live is Christ / to die is gain.
Render politeuesthe explicitly as live as citizens, establishing link to 3:20.
Preserve charizomai grace word-family in note while using natural English in main text.

apparatus: Canonical TSW apparatus used as comparator, with duplicates, formatting defects, over-interpretive headings, lexical inaccuracies, and translation-specific claims corrected for Fluent.
